standard-steer.name: STANDARD STEER
standard-steer.description: The STANDARD STEER Dental Plan is designed to offer essential and reliable dental care at an affordable cost. It focuses on preventive and basic dental treatments. Ideal for individuals and families who want straightforward coverage for check-ups, cleanings, and necessary procedures.

superior-shield.name: SUPERIOR SHIELD
superior-shield.description: SUPERIOR SHIELD is for members who may need implants and surgical dental care, plus preventive maintenance.

smart-saver.name: Smart Saver
smart-saver.description: Smart Saver is a short-term preventive membership (consult, OPG, scaling), often used after dental camps. Validity is typically 1 month from enrolment.
